<b>Massive Mossgrubs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are overgrown [[Mossgrub]]s, bred by the [[Memorium]] to an unnatural size.<ref>Massive Mossgrub [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Unnaturally overgrown Mossgrub, bred within the Citadel's Memorium."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Massive Mossgrubs remain idle until provoked. Once disturbed, they screech and rapidly charge forward, dealing {{damage|2}} on contact, and only stop when they reach a ledge or a wall. After stopping, they turn around and begin crawling slowly in the opposite direction, unless [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is still in their line of sight or they take damage, in which case they charge again.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2
|
* Mother's voice... distant...
* Little sisters... hide away...
* Eat and grow... larger...
* Change... hidden change...
}}

== Location ==
Massive Mossgrubs can be found in the [[Moss Grotto]] section of the [[Memorium]].

== Trivia ==
* Their [[Needolin]] dialogue shows they sense they are far away from their true home.
* Massive Mossgrubs do not respond to the Needolin once they become hostile. The only way to get them to respond is by staying above them and using the [[Spider Strings]] tool.
